content:
Rae (PM): quick report from user tests on Pixel Fold in landscape — sidebar squeezes and table actions end up under the hinge. users miss taps. attaching notes. :mag:
Jun (Design): saw this in prototype too. suggestion: at <=560px switch sidebar to icon-only and convert rows to stacked cards; keep primary status visible and move secondary actions into an "Actions" disclosure.
Mina (Frontend): prefer CSS-first with a tiny JS helper to move the actions node into the disclosure so event handlers stay intact. sample CSS:
@media (max-width:560px){ .resources-table{display:block} .resources-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px} .status-chip{min-height:44px} }
Omar (QA): repro notes: emulator reports 528px width, safe-area inset ~24 each side, effective 480px. tests: touch targets >=44px, rotate, sr-readouts. filing RF-5102.
Jun (Design): copy tweak: disclosure label should be "Actions" not "More" for clarity. Also add visible field labels in stacked mode (not sr-only).
Rae (PM): decision: implement stacked rows + icon-only sidebar at <=560, Actions disclosure for secondary items, feature flag rollout. Mina, estimate?
Mina (Frontend): ~2 dev-days + 1 QA day. will include feature flag and unit tests.
ux-bot: mock uploaded https://assets.redwood.internal/designs/foldable-compact-sidebar-v1.png
Omar (QA): added test ticket RF-5102 with steps. closing unless regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
